node.title: Re^2: Problem executing command via ssh
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Two recent questions suggest that Net::SSH::Perl might be useful

On Windows maybe, but on *NIX systems, IMHO [mod://Net::OpenSSH] is really the best, it supports a ton of functionality and builds on the native ssh. No messing around with IPC::Open3 necessary :-)
